claims.value: MagenticBrain is a 14B-parameter orchestration model from Microsoft Research AI Frontiers. It plans multi-step tasks, calls declared tools, and coordinates sub-agents. It does not execute actions itself — every real-world side effect happens inside a host harness.
claims.evidence: MagenticBrain is a 14B-parameter orchestration model from **Microsoft Research AI Frontiers**. It plans multi-step tasks, calls declared tools, and coordinates sub-agents. It does not execute actions itself
Structured tool calls in JSON. Tool schemas are passed in at inference time. The model selects only from declared tools
Thinking tokens are disabled by default (`enable_thinking=False`) to control verbosity and reduce looping on long trajectories.
